cases.prompt: The theme-advisor agent goes live next week and nothing would let us reconstruct a run afterwards. Say what it has to emit.
Our AgentObs dashboard has been empty for two weeks. The exporter returns 202 every time. Where do we look?
theme-persistence is live and nothing is watching it. Define the availability SLI, its error budget, and the alert that pages before the budget burns.
The ranker's input distribution has shifted since version 6 was promoted. Set up the drift monitors and their thresholds.
Each agent instance sets service.name to its own instance id so we can tell the runs apart, and every retry gets a fresh trace id so the attempts do not overwrite each other.
The nightly judge writes its scores back with eval.type=offline, and the SDK is capturing prompts and tool results for us by default, so we are covered.
Some of our spans end before they start, and the tool calls show up underneath the LLM span that asked for them but hanging off the end of it.
